description: Direct income support of Rs. 6000 per year to small and marginal farmers.
benefit_summary: Rs. 6,000/year in 3 equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 directly credited to bank account.

conditions.description: Applicant must be a farmer or engaged in agriculture.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Annual income must not exceed Rs. 2,00,000 (constitutional income tax exemption threshold for small farmers).
Institutional landholders and higher-income general category excluded (optional check).

description: Micro-credit up to Rs. 50,000 for non-corporate small business units.
benefit_summary: Collateral-free loan up to Rs. 50,000 for micro businesses.

conditions.description: Applicant must run a small business or self-employment activity.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must not exceed 65 years of age.
Loan requirement must be Rs. 50,000 or below for Shishu category.

description: Micro-credit from Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5,00,000 for growing businesses.
benefit_summary: Collateral-free loan between Rs. 50,001 and Rs. 5,00,000.

conditions.description: Applicant must run a small business or self-employment activity.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Loan requirement must exceed Rs. 50,000 (Kishor category lower bound).
Loan requirement must not exceed Rs. 5,00,000 (Kishor category upper bound).

description: Credit-linked subsidy to generate employment through micro enterprises.
benefit_summary: 15-35% margin money subsidy on project cost up to Rs. 25 lakh (service) / Rs. 50 lakh (manufacturing).

conditions.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must have passed at least 8th standard for projects above Rs. 10 lakh.
Applicant must be setting up a new micro enterprise.
Beneficiary annual family income should not exceed Rs. 5,00,000.
Project cost must not exceed Rs. 50,00,000 for manufacturing units.

description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers in case of crop failure.
benefit_summary: Comprehensive crop insurance with premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops.

conditions.description: Applicant must be a farmer.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.

description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
benefit_summary: Composite bank loan of Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore for greenfield enterprises.

conditions.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must be setting up a greenfield enterprise.
Scheme is for SC/ST category entrepreneurs OR women (gender check below).
Women entrepreneurs are eligible regardless of social category.
Minimum loan under this scheme is Rs. 10 lakh.
Maximum loan under this scheme is Rs. 1 crore.

scheme_name: DAY-NRLM Self Help Group Bank Linkage
description: Subsidised credit linkage for women-led Self Help Groups in rural areas.
benefit_summary: Interest subvention on bank loans; 3-7% effective interest rate for SHG members.

conditions.description: Scheme is exclusively for women beneficiaries.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 for rural BPL households.

description: Housing for All scheme providing financial assistance for construction/enhancement of pucca houses.
benefit_summary: Rs. 1.20 lakh in plains and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly/NE/difficult areas.

conditions.description: Beneficiary must belong to a household with annual income up to Rs. 3 lakh.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Priority given to SC/ST/OBC households (optional check — general category may still qualify).

scheme_name: KALIA - Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (Odisha)
description: State scheme providing financial assistance to small, marginal farmers and landless labourers in Odisha.
benefit_summary: Rs. 10,000 per year in 2 instalments for cultivation + Rs. 5,000 for non-cultivation livelihood.

conditions.description: Applicant must be a resident of Odisha.
Applicant must be a farmer or agricultural labourer.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Annual income must be below Rs. 2,00,000.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (Kalaignar)
ministry: Health & Family Welfare Dept., Tamil Nadu
description: Health insurance coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for low-income families in Tamil Nadu.
benefit_summary: Up to Rs. 5,00,000 annual health cover for inpatient treatment at govt/empanelled hospitals.

conditions.description: Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 72,000 (BPL threshold for this scheme).
No minimum age restriction; all family members covered.
